title: isoetes velata subsp. longissima
intro: Isoetes velata subsp. longissima, commonly known as Quillwort, is a rare aquatic plant species that belongs to the family Isoetaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Isoetes velata subsp. longissima are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin from infections.
